name: English
title: Sence: Can't Decide? We Can. · Ask it, the crowd votes
meta_desc: On Sence you ask under a nickname and the crowd votes. This or that, yes or no, how many points? Ask with a photo or just text and see what everyone thinks in seconds. Coming soon to the App Store and Google Play.
og_desc: Stuck on a choice? Ask it, the crowd votes. Nickname only, votes stay private. Coming soon to the App Store and Google Play.
pill: iPhone, iPad and Android · Coming soon
lead: Ask about anything you're stuck on and let the crowd vote with a single swipe. This or that, yes or no, how many points? See what everyone thinks in seconds.
store_soon: Coming soon to the App Store
demo_hint: Slide on the bar, release to vote
shapes_p: Every question is one card. You always answer in the same place: the bar under the card. Try it.
shape_yesno_p: One question, two answers. Slide left for no, right for yes.
shape_choice_p: 2 to 4 options, each a photo or a few words. Let the crowd pick one.
shape_rate_p: A score from 0 to 10. The result shows how the crowd's scores spread, with the average.
how_p: A minute to ask, seconds to get answers.

how.p: Add a photo and write your question in up to 99 characters. Pick a category and a time limit: 10 minutes, 1 to 24 hours, or no limit.
Your question lands in Trending and in your followers' Square. Everyone votes with one swipe. Nobody sees who voted for what, only the numbers.
When time is up the result locks and we let you know. If you like, tell everyone what you picked in the end.

inside_p: Five tabs, one card at a time. Swipe up for the next question.

inside.p: Everyone's questions, ranked for what you're into. The app opens here.
Questions and Resences from people you follow, then suggestions when you're all caught up.
Every question you've voted on, with how it turned out.
Like a question? Ask it again to your own followers.
Public comments and replies. The person asking can turn them off.
Hear when a result is in, when someone comments, or when your question gets resenced.
Send a question or its result to friends as a ready-made Story.
A crystal-clear light theme, or a smoky dark one for late nights.

trust_p: Nobody on Sence is there to judge you. They're just answering your question.

trust.p: No real name, phone number or password. Pick a nickname and you're in.
Nobody is shown who voted for what. Even the person asking only sees numbers.
Every photo is checked before it goes live. Location data is removed while it's still on your phone.
Report a question that bothers you and block someone with one tap. You can also make your account private.
Sence is a community for adults. Rude language is caught before it's posted.
Link Apple or Google so a new phone doesn't mean a lost account. You can delete your account in the app.

faq.a: An app where you ask about things you can't decide on, under a nickname, and the crowd votes. There are three kinds of questions: Yes/No, Pick (2–4 options) and Rate (0–10). “Sence” is Turkish for “what do you think?”.
No. Sence is free to download and use.

faq.q: Can anyone see who voted for what?
faq.a: No. Voters are never shown anywhere. Everyone, including the person asking, sees only percentages and the number of votes.

Your account is created on your phone; you just pick a nickname. So you don't lose it when you switch phones, link it to Apple or Google in Settings, then use “I already have an account” on the new phone.

faq.q: How long does my question stay open?
faq.a: You choose: 10 minutes, 1, 6, 12 or 24 hours, or no limit at all. When time is up the result locks and you get a notification.

faq.q: Which devices does it run on?
faq.a: Sence is coming very soon to the App Store for iPhone and iPad (iOS 17.6 or later) and to Google Play for Android.

In 16 languages: English, Turkish, German, French, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Simplified), Hindi and Indonesian. Sence opens in your phone's language.

support_desc: Help with Sence: getting your account back, deleting your account, reporting and blocking, nicknames and notifications. Write to destek.anbertech@gmail.com.
support_lead: Something not working, or an idea to share? Write to us and we'll get back to you soon.

support_faq.q: I got a new phone. How do I get my account back?
support_faq.a: If you linked your account to Apple or Google, tap “I already have an account” on the welcome screen and sign in with the same one. Without a link the old account can't be recovered, so we recommend linking it in Settings → Account.

support_faq.q: How do I delete my account?
support_faq.a: Settings → Account → Delete account, then confirm in two steps. Your nickname, questions, comments and follows are deleted for good; your votes stay in the counts, without your identity. Your nickname becomes available to others after 30 days.

support_faq.q: How do I report a question or a person?
support_faq.a: Open the “…” menu at the top right of the card and choose Report question. To report or block a person, use the “…” menu on their profile. You can also press and hold a comment to report it.
Go to Settings → Blocked accounts and tap Unblock. The person isn't notified when you block them.
Yes: Settings → My info → Nickname. You can change it once every 30 days.
Make sure notifications are on in iPhone Settings → Notifications → Sence. In the app, choose which ones you want under Settings → Notifications.

support_legal: Legal requests and content removal requests can go to the same address. Please include a link to the question or profile in question.
